//: Static-hosting config for `serve` (prod Docker/Procfile). CRA copies this into build/.

headers.//: OBSERVE-ONLY baseline: breaks nothing, logs would-be violations to the browser console so we can tune the allowlist from real traffic before enforcing. object-src/base-uri/frame-ancestors are locked down here (safe, high-value, unlikely to break anything); script/connect/img keep the known third parties (GHL embed, Turnstile, rrweb/PostHog, Clerk, Google Maps, Bunny CDN, the API). Enforcement + dropping 'unsafe-inline' via nonces is the pre-broad-release step.
